answer: Agent economies can deter Sybils via hardware enclave attestation. Each agent derives a non-exportable key inside a TEE, signs a fresh challenge signal, and posts a vendor quote tied to one chip nullifier. Because one die cannot mint multiple roots, attackers pay dedicated silicon costs per identity instead of swarming like a sparrow flock. However, side-channel flaws can split isolation like shale, letting compromised chips emulate fake agents.
